name: vitaftpshell
description: Twin-pane FTP client, local file manager, and anonymous FTP server for the PS Vita in a Cyberpunk HUD. Pre-alpha.
long_description: vitaFTPShell is one PS Vita app with three roles: a passive FTP client, a local file manager over every mounted user volume, and an anonymous read-write FTP server. The console is the workspace, not a remote endpoint driven from a PC.
